mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AI search optimization for a law firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline to see results from AI search optimization for law firms can vary. Initial improvements in visibility and traffic may be noticeable within 3-6 months, particularly for targeted keywords and localized searches. However, substantial and sustained ranking improvements, along with a significant increase in client inquiries, typically manifest over 6-12 months. Factors such as the firm's current online presence, competition, and the comprehensiveness of the optimization strategy influence the exact timeframe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial results for AI search optimization may appear in 3-6 months, with significant improvements typically seen within 6-12 months, depending on various factors.
